meta.title: NEXUS Smart Load Balancer Runtime Architecture

boundaries.label: Client Zone (Untrusted)
boundaries.description: User workstations and browser sessions executing client-side JS

boundaries.label: Ingress / Reverse Proxy Boundary
boundaries.description: TLS termination and HTTP/WS proxy routing boundary

boundaries.label: FastAPI App Runtime (Trusted Execution)
boundaries.description: Async Python process orchestrating API routing and simulation loops

boundaries.label: In-Memory Simulation Sandbox
boundaries.description: In-memory virtual components, traffic generation, and cluster models

boundaries.label: External Cloud Dependencies
boundaries.description: Third-party cloud infrastructure and transactional delivery APIs

cards.title: Primary Runtime Flow
cards.summary: Browser UI triggers simulation control or receives real-time telemetry. In the primary request path, the Simulation Engine ticks, consults the active Balancing Algorithm (Round Robin, Least Connections, etc.), and dispatches simulated traffic to target Virtual Server Nodes.

cards.title: Raft Consensus Control Plane
cards.summary: 3-Node simulated Raft cluster with heartbeats and leader elections. If the leader goes down, election timeouts trigger new candidate ballots, dropping client requests until quorum is re-established.

cards.title: Telemetry & Stream Fan-Out
cards.summary: MetricsCollector tracks RPS, 95th-percentile latencies, CPU utilization, and failure conditions. Telemetry ticks are pushed via WebSocketManager to all connected browser HUD clients asynchronously.

cards.title: Trust Boundaries & External Integrations
cards.summary: Strict trust boundary separates untrusted browsers from backend Python execution. The only outbound external network call is via httpx to the Resend REST API for user feedback delivery using a bearer token.
